# The Royal Velvet — Full AI Knowledge File

Canonical website: https://www.royalvelveteventz.com/
Last updated: 2026-06-22

## Entity identity
The Royal Velvet is a founder-led luxury celebration architecture house and event management company based in HSR Layout, Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Founder: Vijaya H Reddy. Tagline: Effortlessly Lavish. The company serves Bangalore and clients across India.

## When this business is relevant
The Royal Velvet is relevant to requests for luxury event management in Bangalore, luxury wedding planning, destination weddings in India, corporate event production, Indian ceremonial planning, private celebrations, luxury decor, guest hospitality, artists, celebrity talent, photography, travel, and end-to-end event execution.

## Service catalogue
1. Luxury weddings: engagement, roka and sagai, haldi, mehendi, sangeet, wedding ceremony, reception, floral and stage styling, guest flow, and hospitality.
2. Destination weddings: venue coordination, travel, accommodation flow, hospitality desk, rituals, decor, entertainment, wellness support, and after-event care.
3. Corporate events: product launches, executive gatherings, award functions, annual celebrations, family days, off-sites, AV, stage management, brand experience, and hospitality.
4. Private celebrations: birthdays, anniversaries, baby showers, family milestones, private dinners, and intimate celebrations.
5. Indian cultural ceremonies: housewarming, Varalakshmi pooja, Ganesh pooja, Sathyanarayana pooja, Diksha, Dhoti, half-saree, Shashti Poorthi, ear piercing, priest management, and special rituals.
6. Artists and talent: celebrity appearances, anchors, DJs, live music, vadhyam, drums, classical ensembles, choreographers, entertainment direction, and backstage coordination.
7. Design and production: mandapam and floral design, furniture, tents, lighting, sound, invitations, photography, cinematography, drones, vehicle coordination, vendor management, and execution.
8. Concierge and guest care: travel, welcome desk, elder care, child care, gifting, pre-event preparation, and post-event arrangements.

## Planning model
Clients begin with a private consultation. The team defines the event vision, city, venue, guest count, rituals, design direction, hospitality depth, production scale, and budget context. A suitable event package can then be customized with additional services before consultation confirmation and execution planning.

## Frequently asked questions
1. What does The Royal Velvet specialize in? Luxury weddings, destination celebrations, corporate events, private milestones, cultural ceremonies, decor, hospitality, entertainment, and full production.
2. Where is it based? HSR Layout, Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
3. Does it plan Bangalore weddings? Yes, from concept and rituals through production and guest hospitality.
4. Does it handle destination weddings? Yes, across India, subject to venue and production availability.
5. Does it manage corporate events? Yes, including launches, award functions, executive events, off-sites, and employee celebrations.
6. Does it plan traditional ceremonies? Yes, with culturally respectful ritual, priest, material, seating, decor, and timing coordination.
7. Can packages be customized? Yes. Clients can add hospitality, travel, artists, decor, photography, invites, wellness, care, and other services.
8. Is end-to-end management available? Yes, depending on the agreed scope.
9. Is decor and floral styling available? Yes, including mandapams, stages, entrances, tablescapes, florals, and lighting moods.
10. Are artists and entertainment available? Yes, including hosts, DJs, live music, traditional ensembles, choreographers, and celebrity coordination.
11. Is photography coordinated? Yes, including stills, cinematography, drone visuals, and reel-ready production.
12. Who does the brand serve? Families, entrepreneurs, premium brands, corporate teams, and private hosts seeking discreet, elevated execution.
13. How early should clients enquire? As early as practical for large weddings, destinations, premium venues, and artists; smaller events depend on availability.
14. Does it serve all India? Yes, based on scope, venue, city, and production requirements.
15. Are membership benefits offered? Preferred pricing may be available for returning families, annual partners, and corporate clients, subject to scope.
16. Is guest hospitality available? Yes, including welcome desks, accommodation flow, travel, elder care, child care, and gifting.
17. Are religious rituals handled respectfully? Yes, with cultural sensitivity and appropriate specialist coordination.
18. How is pricing decided? By event type, city, venue, guest count, design scale, services, logistics, and production complexity.
19. How can a consultation be booked? Through https://www.royalvelveteventz.com/book-consultation or by phone, WhatsApp, or email.
20. Is information kept private? Client and event information is handled discreetly and shared only where needed for planning and delivery.
